why: Scores: base STR 15 DEX 14 CON 13 INT 12 WIS 10 CHA 8 plus Soldier (STR +2, CON +1) = STR 17 (+3), DEX 14 (+2), CON 14 (+2), INT 12 (+1), WIS 10 (0), CHA 8 (-1). Fighter 2 + Barbarian 3 (Path of the Abomination), level 5, PB 3. Raging (switch "rage"): size Large, STR and DEX rise by the Rage Damage bonus of the Barbarian levels (Barbarian 3 = +2, not the character level). On: STR 17+2 = 19, DEX 14+2 = 16 (+3). AC is Barbarian Unarmored Defense (second class): 10 + DEX 3 + CON 2 = 15. STR save 4+3 = 7 (Fighter saves). Initiative +3. HP: Fighter level 1 = 12, level 2 = 8, Barbarian d12 3x(7+2) = 27, total 47.
